title: HiRISE digital terrain model of Jezero crater (DTEEC_023524_1985_023379_1985_U01)
agency: NASA MRO HiRISE / University of Arizona
qualityNotes: 1 m/pixel stereo terrain; small-scale stereo noise removed with a 3x3 box filter.
transforms: HTTP range read of 240 lines x 210 samples starting at line 3960, sample 3480.
3x3 smoothing, sampled every 2 m, heights made relative to the outpost (data/jezero-terrain.js).
Flattened near the outpost pad; one authored rim mound added for the Rim track.
limitation: Real terrain shape for a fictional outpost. The small window is somewhere inside the crater, not a specific rover spot. Routes, hazards and rocks are authored.

title: Opportunity rover solar energy during the June 2018 planet-encircling dust storm
agency: NASA JPL MER team (reported by The Planetary Society)
location: Perseverance Valley, Endeavour crater, Meridiani Planum
qualityNotes: Values are as quoted in MER team updates; sol 5107 tau was only estimated above 3.0.
transforms: Energy per sol divided by the pre-storm 645 Wh to give a sunlight fraction (data/opportunity-2018.js).
Five days of real decline are squeezed into the storm chapter's preparation time.
limitation: Shape of a real power drop, compressed in time. Base power numbers in the game are simplified percentages, not rover engineering data.

title: Microbiological and Nutritional Analysis of Lettuce Crops Grown on the International Space Station
agency: Frontiers in Plant Science; study of NASA Veggie ISS experiments
version: Frontiers in Plant Science, volume 11, article 199
qualityNotes: Paper reports a fan status readout of LOW while the fan was actually off after power cycling.
The authors describe excess early moisture, likely due to a fan malfunction.
The authors state that incomplete environmental logging prevents assigning a causal link between microbial findings and chamber conditions.
transforms: Use as a qualitative scenario clue for checking actual airflow against an equipment indicator.
Do not transfer the paper's fan anomaly into a Mars hardware repair procedure or infer microbial safety from visual moisture.
limitation: ISS experiment context only. The fictional Mars fan reset, leaf-surface moisture index, stress response and outcomes are authored training rules, not measured NASA values.

title: Curiosity RAD and the 20 May 2024 solar particle event
qualityNotes: Manually transcribed from a dated NASA/JPL event summary. This record does not contain raw RAD telemetry.
transforms: Divide the reported absorbed dose by 81 µGy per training point to set the outdoor baseline.
limitation: The detector reference is specific to one event at Curiosity. Base Boss shelter factors and exposure points are authored and do not estimate astronaut dose.
